//! The string-free core of a scenario that requests one effect per check
//! at the start and reports each check when its result arrives (plan P26).
//! Effect `i` is `EffectId { command: 0, index: i }`. Teeth decide with
//! these functions; Verus proves their contracts, and teeth's proofs use
//! the contracts, not the bodies.
//!
//! In flight is derived, not stored: once started, every check not yet
//! reported is in flight.
use suite_bridge_core::{EffectId, MAX_IN_FLIGHT};
use vstd::prelude::*;

use crate::Reject;

verus! {

/// The command that requests every effect.
pub const START: u32 = 0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Ledger {
    pub started: bool,
    /// How many checks; at most `MAX_IN_FLIGHT`, since all are requested
    /// at once.
    pub checks: u8,
    /// Bit `i`: check `i` was reported.
    pub reported: u8,
}

// ---- Specification ----
/// What [`id`] computes.
pub open spec fn id_spec(index: u8) -> EffectId {
    EffectId { command: START, index }
}

/// What [`bit`] computes.
pub open spec fn bit_spec(index: u8) -> u8 {
    if index < 8 {
        1u8 << index
    } else {
        0
    }
}

/// What [`all_bits`] computes.
pub open spec fn all_bits_spec(checks: u8) -> u8 {
    if checks >= 8 {
        u8::MAX
    } else {
        ((1u8 << checks) - 1) as u8
    }
}

/// What [`in_flight`] computes.
pub open spec fn in_flight_spec(l: Ledger) -> u8 {
    if l.started {
        all_bits_spec(l.checks) & !l.reported
    } else {
        0
    }
}

/// What [`invariant`] computes.
pub open spec fn inv(l: Ledger) -> bool {
    &&& l.checks <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT
    &&& l.reported & !all_bits_spec(l.checks) == 0
    &&& l.started || l.reported == 0
}

/// What [`done`] computes.
pub open spec fn done_spec(l: Ledger) -> bool {
    l.started && l.reported == all_bits_spec(l.checks)
}

/// What [`admit`] promises, given the invariant: the start only once, and
/// a result only for an effect in flight.
pub open spec fn admit_spec(
    l: Ledger,
    result: Option<EffectId>,
    r: Result<Option<u8>, Reject>,
) -> bool {
    match (r, result) {
        (Ok(None), None) => !l.started,
        (Ok(Some(i)), Some(e)) => e == id_spec(i) && i < l.checks && in_flight_spec(l) & bit_spec(i)
            != 0,
        (Ok(_), _) => false,
        (Err(_), None) => l.started,
        (Err(_), Some(e)) => e.command != START || e.index >= l.checks || in_flight_spec(l)
            & bit_spec(e.index) == 0,
    }
}

// ---- Lemmas ----
/// A bit below `checks` is one of `all_bits(checks)`.
proof fn lemma_bit_within(i: u8, checks: u8)
    requires
        i < checks <= 8,
    ensures
        bit_spec(i) != 0,
        bit_spec(i) & !all_bits_spec(checks) == 0,
{
    if checks == 8 {
        assert((1u8 << i) != 0 && (1u8 << i) & !0xffu8 == 0) by (bit_vector)
            requires
                i < 8,
        ;
    } else {
        assert((1u8 << i) != 0 && (1u8 << i) & !(((1u8 << checks) - 1) as u8) == 0) by (bit_vector)
            requires
                i < checks < 8,
        ;
    }
}

/// Before the start, nothing is in flight.
proof fn lemma_zero_and(x: u8)
    ensures
        0u8 & x == 0,
{
    assert(0u8 & x == 0) by (bit_vector);
}

/// Every check reported: nothing in flight.
proof fn lemma_done_empty(all: u8, reported: u8, b: u8)
    requires
        reported == all,
    ensures
        all & !reported & b == 0,
{
    assert(all & !all & b == 0) by (bit_vector);
}

// ---- Code ----
#[must_use]
pub fn id(index: u8) -> (r: EffectId)
    ensures
        r == id_spec(index),
{
    EffectId { command: START, index }
}

/// Bit `index`; zero past the width.
#[must_use]
pub fn bit(index: u8) -> (r: u8)
    ensures
        r == bit_spec(index),
{
    if index < 8 {
        1u8 << index
    } else {
        0
    }
}

/// Bits `0..checks`.
#[must_use]
pub fn all_bits(checks: u8) -> (r: u8)
    ensures
        r == all_bits_spec(checks),
{
    if checks >= 8 {
        u8::MAX
    } else {
        assert((1u8 << checks) >= 1) by (bit_vector)
            requires
                checks < 8,
        ;
        bit(checks) - 1
    }
}

/// The checks whose effects are in flight.
#[must_use]
pub fn in_flight(l: Ledger) -> (r: u8)
    ensures
        r == in_flight_spec(l),
{
    if l.started {
        all_bits(l.checks) & !l.reported
    } else {
        0
    }
}

/// The invariant: at most `MAX_IN_FLIGHT` checks, only those reported,
/// and none before the start.
#[must_use]
pub fn invariant(l: &Ledger) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == inv(*l),
{
    usize::from(l.checks) <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT && l.reported & !all_bits(l.checks) == 0 && (l.started
        || l.reported == 0)
}

/// A ledger of `checks` checks, not started.
#[must_use]
pub fn new(checks: u8) -> (r: Ledger)
    ensures
        r == (Ledger { started: false, checks, reported: 0 }),
        checks <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT ==> inv(r),
{
    let r = Ledger { started: false, checks, reported: 0 };
    assert(0u8 & !all_bits_spec(checks) == 0) by {
        let a = all_bits_spec(checks);
        assert(0u8 & !a == 0) by (bit_vector);
    }
    r
}

/// Whether the ledger admits a command: the start (`None`) or the result
/// of effect `Some(id)`. `Ok` carries the check a result reports.
///
/// # Errors
/// A second start, a result before the start or after the end, or a
/// result for an effect not in flight.
pub fn admit(l: Ledger, result: Option<EffectId>) -> (r: Result<Option<u8>, Reject>)
    requires
        inv(l),
    ensures
        admit_spec(l, result, r),
{
    match result {
        None if l.started => Err(Reject::AlreadyStarted),
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(_) if !l.started => {
            proof {
                lemma_zero_and(bit_spec(result->0.index));
            }
            Err(Reject::NotStarted)
        },
        Some(_) if done(l) => {
            proof {
                lemma_done_empty(all_bits_spec(l.checks), l.reported, bit_spec(result->0.index));
            }
            Err(Reject::Finished)
        },
        Some(e) if e.command == START && e.index < l.checks && in_flight(l) & bit(e.index) != 0 => {
            Ok(Some(e.index))
        },
        Some(_) => Err(Reject::NotInFlight),
    }
}

/// Every effect requested.
#[must_use]
pub fn start(l: Ledger) -> (r: Ledger)
    requires
        inv(l),
        !l.started,
    ensures
        inv(r),
        r.started,
        r.checks == l.checks,
        r.reported == l.reported,
        in_flight_spec(r) == all_bits_spec(l.checks),
{
    let mut r = l;
    r.started = true;
    assert(all_bits_spec(l.checks) & !0u8 == all_bits_spec(l.checks)) by {
        let a = all_bits_spec(l.checks);
        assert(a & !0u8 == a) by (bit_vector);
    }
    r
}

/// Check `index` reported: its effect leaves the flight.
#[must_use]
pub fn reported(l: Ledger, index: u8) -> (r: Ledger)
    requires
        inv(l),
        index < l.checks,
        in_flight_spec(l) & bit_spec(index) != 0,
    ensures
        inv(r),
        r.started,
        r.checks == l.checks,
        r.reported == l.reported | bit_spec(index),
        in_flight_spec(r) == in_flight_spec(l) & !bit_spec(index),
{
    proof {
        lemma_zero_and(bit_spec(index));
        lemma_bit_within(index, l.checks);
        let a = all_bits_spec(l.checks);
        let p = l.reported;
        let b = bit_spec(index);
        assert((p | b) & !a == 0 && a & !(p | b) == (a & !p) & !b) by (bit_vector)
            requires
                p & !a == 0,
                b & !a == 0,
        ;
    }
    let mut r = l;
    r.reported = l.reported | bit(index);
    r
}

/// Started and every check reported: nothing is in flight.
#[must_use]
pub fn done(l: Ledger) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == done_spec(l),
{
    l.started && l.reported == all_bits(l.checks)
}

/// Liveness, one step at a time: every check in flight is admitted, and a
/// started ledger with nothing in flight is done. (Safety alone holds for
/// a ledger that admits nothing.)
pub proof fn lemma_live(l: Ledger, i: u8)
    requires
        inv(l),
    ensures
        in_flight_spec(l) & bit_spec(i) != 0 ==> i < l.checks && !done_spec(l),
        l.started && in_flight_spec(l) == 0 ==> done_spec(l),
{
    let a = all_bits_spec(l.checks);
    let p = l.reported;
    let b = bit_spec(i);
    lemma_zero_and(b);
    if in_flight_spec(l) & b != 0 {
        if i >= l.checks {
            if i >= 8 {
                assert(b == 0);
                assert(a & !p & 0u8 == 0) by (bit_vector);
            } else if l.checks == 8 {
            } else {
                let c = l.checks;
                assert((1u8 << i) & (((1u8 << c) - 1) as u8) == 0) by (bit_vector)
                    requires
                        c <= i < 8,
                ;
                assert(a & !p & b == 0) by (bit_vector)
                    requires
                        b & a == 0,
                ;
            }
        }
        if done_spec(l) {
            lemma_done_empty(a, p, b);
        }
    }
    if l.started && in_flight_spec(l) == 0 {
        assert(p == a) by (bit_vector)
            requires
                p & !a == 0,
                a & !p == 0,
        ;
    }
}

/// The other half of the liveness harness: `admit`'s contract leaves it
/// one answer for the result of a check in flight, the report of that check.
pub proof fn lemma_in_flight_admitted(l: Ledger, i: u8, r: Result<Option<u8>, Reject>)
    requires
        inv(l),
        in_flight_spec(l) & bit_spec(i) != 0,
        admit_spec(l, Some(id_spec(i)), r),
    ensures
        r == Ok::<Option<u8>, Reject>(Some(i)),
{
    lemma_live(l, i);
}

} // verus!
